mode: expanded spatial metadata discovery with pagination and raw source records; existing image downloads preserved
incremental_policy: New IDs are appended; existing IDs are enriched with newly available non-empty fields; prior values are retained when the API omits them. No existing image files are deleted.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the area derived from imported building footprints, the public API response, and 500 sampled spatial cells; this is broader and paginated but cannot guarantee the provider exposes every city photo.
Image URLs and raw API records are indexed when exposed by the API; image binaries are not automatically downloaded by this metadata script.
GPS points and sequence metadata describe capture coverage, not verified road signs or extracted lane/traffic-sign detections.
